sequence: fresh timing origin and collision check
intake creates approved root and seven containers once
selected input identity check and raw copies
root writes INTAKE.json with stage-specific completion only
root reads and validates all three actual files and hashes
root writes READY_INPUTS.json containing exact existing input paths/identities and separate intended outputs
root rereads READY_INPUTS before any implementation delegation or source access by role

owners.creator: intake
owners.rules: Exclusive creation; root must be absent; validate intended parents/reparse flags; no overwrite/delete/fallback

owners.creator: launcher
owners.rules: CreateNew after preseal and empty-container readback; reservation prevents second session; preserve partial logs on error

owners.creator: offline harness
owners.rules: Create each used case directory once after test start; no pre-creation by intake/launcher

owners.creator: FilePorts under live harness orchestration
owners.rules: Confirm actual constructor ownership before seal; exactly one creator per directory, avoid harness/FilePorts double mkdir

owners.creator: owned receiver session start
owners.rules: One owned session only, only after F01..F10 succeed

owners.creator: root authoring before seal
owners.rules: Only approved new output names; existing input source files unchanged

owners.creator: root preservation phase
owners.rules: New records only; no changes to sealed inputs or previous stopped work

seal_scope: Source/contract/engine/harness/individual fixtures/argv/cwd frozen before test; results/delivery append-only outputs excluded from immutable source set but inventoried separately
completion_rule: Do not label overall intake complete based only on directory creation or CONFIG. All required contract/identity/readback steps must be evidenced.
